message.dairatz.hollow.empty: Bring your fairy here on your head to settle her.

message.dairatz.hollow.unavailable: The resident is unavailable or too far away.

message.dairatz.hollow.away: The resident is outside. This home is still hers.
message.dairatz.hollow.knocked: The fairy comes out to investigate.
message.dairatz.hollow.head_full: A fairy is already sitting on your head.
message.dairatz.hollow.not_owner: This fairy does not belong to you.
